summary: Third retest of RibhShare Phase 1 first-time sign-in flows (FLOW 1..4) after implementation of mustSetPassword flag in useAuthStore. ALL 4 FLOWS NOW PASS. The AuthGuard race documented in iter_8 and iter_9 is fully resolved. The mustSetPassword flag correctly short-circuits the AuthGuard while FirstSigninScreen owns navigation from /first-signin -> /set-password, and SetPasswordScreen clears it on successful password save. IMPORTANT NOTE: the fix only became observable AFTER `sudo supervisorctl restart expo-web` — Expo web's Metro cache was still serving stale bundle from previous iteration; hot reload alone was insufficient to reflect the newly-added mustSetPassword store field + AuthGuard early-return. Main agent should be aware of this whenever similar zustand-store-shape changes are made.

Deep-link likely falls back because investors don't have access to /(tabs)/projects list (they use /(tabs)/portfolio/projects/{id}). Confirm the intended landing route for a newly-onboarded investor — currently the acceptance criterion 'a tab route' IS satisfied, but the projectId is lost.

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: after every zustand store-shape change (like adding mustSetPassword), remember to `sudo supervisorctl restart expo-web` because Expo's Metro sometimes serves a stale bundle even with hot reload.

OPTIONAL: SetPasswordScreen redirects to /(tabs)/projects/{projectId} but for an INVESTOR that route resolves to /home (list view of projects, then no-op fallback). Consider redirecting to /(tabs)/portfolio/projects/{projectId} or /(tabs)/invitations/{inviteId} so the investor lands on their invitation review screen instead of a generic tab.
OPTIONAL: fix the circular import CreateProjectWizard <-> CreateProjectStepDocuments to remove the Require cycle warning.
critical_code_review_comments: useAuthStore.setSession still hard-codes user.role = 'INVESTOR' as an interim value (line 36). This is a foot-gun for CEO / LM signing in fresh; the role briefly flips in the store until fetchProfile lands. Consider setting user.role = null (or undefined) at setSession time and populating it exclusively from fetchProfile via updateUser.

AuthGuard now correctly short-circuits when mustSetPassword=true. Consider adding a defensive timer/watchdog: if mustSetPassword stays true for > N seconds without navigating to /set-password (e.g. because verifyOtp failed silently), reset it so a stale flag doesn't lock the user out of the auth guard forever. Today it is only cleared in FirstSigninScreen.catch and SetPasswordScreen.submit success, which is fine for the happy paths but relies on those paths always running.

FirstSigninScreen: the pushToast on password-already-set branch fires AFTER router.replace(getDefaultTabRoute(role)) — with expo-router this can drop the toast if it dismounts the ToastProvider tree during navigation. Consider pushing the toast BEFORE calling router.replace.

rca of the issue:
Not applicable — no bug found in this iteration. Previous iterations (iter_8, iter_9) documented the AuthGuard race; this iteration confirms it is resolved by the mustSetPassword approach recommended in iter_9. Full trace captured from the browser console:

1. /first-signin loaded — AuthGuard: {session:false, mustSetPassword:false} — no redirect.
2. Submit -> redeemInviteCode returns {passwordAlreadySet:false, projectId:...}.
3. FirstSigninScreen calls setMustSetPassword(true) BEFORE verifyMagicToken.
4. AuthGuard re-renders — {session:false, mustSetPassword:true} — early return.
5. verifyMagicToken awaits, onAuthStateChange fires, setSession(session) called — AuthGuard re-renders — {session:true, role:null, mustSetPassword:true} — early return.
6. fetchProfile resolves — setRole(INVESTOR) — AuthGuard re-renders — {session:true, role:INVESTOR, mustSetPassword:true} — early return.
7. FirstSigninScreen calls router.replace('/set-password?projectId=...').
8. AuthGuard on /set-password with mustSetPassword:true — early return; page mounts.
9. Password + confirm entered, submit clicked.
10. setPasswordAndMark succeeds -> setMustSetPassword(false) -> pushToast('Password set') -> router.replace('/(tabs)/projects/{id}').
11. AuthGuard re-renders — {session:true, mustSetPassword:false, inAuthGroup:false} — no redirect; investor lands on tab (finally /home in this run because /(tabs)/projects/{id} doesn't match an investor-accessible route; see action item).
